interpretation.weights: Mapped habitat classes only; unknown remains generic. RGB = meadow/open/garden/scrub, wood, explicit rock. Bilinear transitions affect appearance only.
interpretation.shore: Distance to the union of existing OSM water outlines, including islands. Unsigned, capped at 16 m. No water depth or flow measurement.
interpretation.slope: Existing IGN normals only; exposed mineral colouring is an artistic interpretation, not a geological survey.
interpretation.finish: Mission 18: jittered metric grass fibres, leaf relief, fixed world rotation, seasonal tint and shared rainfall wetness. Existing licensed rock pixels retained exactly.
